classification_rules.invalid: Input/protocol/source SHA mismatch, cohort/reproducibility mismatch, pre-score commit absent, data leakage, missing control, incomplete output/audit.
classification_rules.mixed: One or more improvements (correct, false, accuracy) without all six GO checks; no scientific support.
classification_rules.negative: No composite GO, including a null or negative-transfer finding, provided execution and independent audit are valid.
classification_rules.supported: All six code-defined go_checks true: gate stationary correct >= fixed uniform +3; gate correct >= fixed memory; gate false <= fixed uniform; 0 foreign/null accepted; gate correct > random gate; gate all-world heldout accuracy >= fixed uniform. One-seed external development GO only; never native scientific PASS.

controls: CART depth2 and RF16 depth3 conventional learner, 144 fit examples, control score thresholds not fully matched

frozen_design.capacity: 16 fixed Boolean two-cause mechanisms, 35% independent outcome flips; no hidden-model capacity increase; exact prior unchanged
frozen_design.compute_budget: One deterministic CPU cohort, no hyperparameter search, no additional scoring attempts; single-threaded sklearn RF16; stop on invalid audit
frozen_design.evaluator: Exact table identification on 52 stationary worlds with 90% posterior cutoff and held-out 288-observation binomial misfit p >0.01; all arms common heldout p threshold, conventional no comparable posterior; foreign/null acceptance counts; overall held-out accuracy; CPU process time per arm, acquisition cost disclosed
frozen_design.ordering: Groups are seeded/shuffled once; within-world balanced 4-action blocks; fit, then independent validation; no scored reruns
frozen_design.split: 80 new world assignments, separate 144 fitting and 288 held-out validation labels per world; historical 80-world seed 929200101 is never reused

hypothesis: A fixed likelihood-ratio memory gate, based only on first 36 fitting observations, avoids the adverse effect of the original historical prior and improves exact stationary-mechanism discovery over the uninformed uniform prior.

inputs.name: LR-92AA learned prior, exact 16 float64 values
inputs.source: LR92AA_RESULT.json memory_prior, parent archive hash recorded; synthetic-only no personal data

intervention_policy: Balanced random fit actions shared identically among arms, no adaptive selection. Gate at exactly 36 first observations: use historical memory only if log p(fit36 | learned prior) - log p(fit36 | uniform prior) >= log(2); otherwise uniform. Fit fixed 144 using selected prior; never sees validation labels.
metrics: all-in fitting/validation and inherited prior acquisition actions
preregistration_note: Protocol must be committed on GitHub before running/inspecting first primary result. This is independent synthetic research, not Yggdrasil native model training. The parent LR-92AA was historically UNPREREGISTERED on GitHub; do not reclassify it.
question: Can intervention-evidence-based rejection of a historically learned but potentially misleading causal prior prevent negative transfer on unseen synthetic worlds?
